name: kalide-rename
body: Product rename, hard cut: the product formerly "ey-present"/"eypres" is named "kalide" (Kalón + Slide) everywhere, with no backward compatibility. Repo: git@github.com:really-knows-ai/kalide.git. Go module path: `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` (all imports). CLI binary: `kalide` built from `cmd/kalide` (`kalide init`, `kalide start`, `kalide templates`); release assets named `kalide-<os>-<arch>`. Deck config file: `kalide.yaml`; `eypres.yaml` is no longer recognised (a project with only `eypres.yaml` is treated as having no deck config). Environment variables: `KALIDE_*` (e.g. `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `KALIDE_BINARY`); `EYPRES_*` are no longer read. Packaging: `Formula/kalide.rb`, `bucket/kalide.json`, Homebrew tap `really-knows-ai/kalide`, Scoop bucket `kalide`; all URLs point at really-knows-ai/kalide. AC: `go.mod` declares `github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide`; a case-insensitive search of the source tree (excluding git history and vendored third-party code) finds no `eypres`, `ey-present` or `EYPRES_`; `kalide init` writes `kalide.yaml`; `kalide start` in a dir with only `eypres.yaml` does not read it; setting only `EYPRES_*` vars has no effect; releases publish `kalide-<os>-<arch>` assets.
